name: CatchLogWithoutException
xpath:
//MethodCall
  [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger')
    or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger')
    or pmd-java:typeIs('org.jboss.logging.BasicLogger') or pmd-java:typeIs('io.quarkus.logging.Log')]]
  [@MethodName = ('warn', 'error', 'fatal', 'warnf', 'errorf', 'fatalf', 'warnv', 'errorv', 'fatalv',
                  'warning', 'severe')
    or (@MethodName = ('log', 'logf', 'logv')
        and ArgumentList/*[1][self::FieldAccess][@Name = ('WARN', 'WARNING', 'ERROR', 'FATAL', 'SEVERE')])]
  [let $catch := ancestor::CatchClause[1],
       $caught := string($catch/CatchParameter/VariableId/@Name),
       $arguments := ArgumentList/*
   return exists($catch)
     and not(matches($caught, '^(?:_|ignore\w*|expected\w*|unused\w*)$', 'i'))
     and empty(($arguments | $arguments/ArrayInitializer/*)[not(self::NullLiteral)]
       [(self::VariableAccess and @Name = $caught)
         or (self::CastExpression and *[last()][self::VariableAccess and @Name = $caught])
         or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Throwable')
         or (self::ConstructorCall and ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $caught])])
     and empty($catch/Block//ThrowStatement[*[1][(self::VariableAccess and @Name = $caught)
         or (self::ConstructorCall and ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $caught])]])]
message: This log call in a catch leaves the caught exception out, so the stack trace and the cause are lost. SLF4J and Log4j 2 take the exception last (log.warn("could not load '{'}", id, e)); JBoss Logging and Quarkus Log take it first in the formatted forms (log.warnf(e, "could not load %s", id)) and last in log.warn("could not load", e); java.util.logging and System.Logger take log(Level.WARNING, "could not load", e). Name the catch parameter ignored when the failure is expected and needs no trace.

name: CleanupSkippedOnFailure
xpath:
let $releases := ('close', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'shutdown', 'shutdownNow', 'stop', 'terminate', 'unsubscribe', 'dispose', 'quit'),
    $throwing := ('close', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'stop', 'terminate', 'unsubscribe', 'dispose', 'quit'),
    $cleanup := ('close', 'dispose', 'destroy', 'shutdown', 'stop', 'teardown', 'tearDown', 'disconnect', 'end', 'cleanup'),
    $hooks := ('org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach', 'org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll', 'org.junit.After',
               'org.junit.AfterClass', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterMethod', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterClass',
               'org.testng.annotations.AfterSuite', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterTest',
               'javax.annotation.PreDestroy', 'jakarta.annotation.PreDestroy'),
    $releasing := function($statement) { exists($statement/MethodCall[@MethodName = $releases]) }
return //MethodDeclaration[@Name = $cleanup or ModifierList/Annotation[some $hook in $hooks satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($hook)]]
  /Block/ExpressionStatement[MethodCall[@MethodName = $throwing]]
  [not(MethodCall[*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService')]])]
  [empty(preceding-sibling::ExpressionStatement[$releasing(.)])]
  [exists(following-sibling::ExpressionStatement[$releasing(.)
      or AssignmentExpression[*[2][self::NullLiteral]]
      or MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear']])]
message: This release can throw, so the release or reset after it in the same block never runs and a connection stays open or the state is not reset. Release each resource in try-with-resources or try/finally (or catch each release and rethrow the first failure after the rest ran), or hold them in one AutoCloseable list closed with addSuppressed. An exception fits only when a failed release should abort the remaining ones.

  [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('final', 'volatile'))]
  [not(ModifierList/Annotation[not(@SimpleName = ('Deprecated', 'SuppressWarnings'))])]

         [not(ancestor::*[self::ClassBody or self::EnumBody or self::RecordBody][1]

         [not(self::VariableAccess and ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration
                or self::LambdaExpression or self::Initializer][1]//VariableId[@Name = $name])],
       $reads := $body//*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][@Name = $name][@AccessType = 'READ']
         [ancestor::*[self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::Initializer]

message: Field {0} is only assigned during initialization; declare it final.

name: GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode
xpath:
//(ClassDeclaration | RecordDeclaration | EnumDeclaration | MethodDeclaration | ConstructorDeclaration | CompactConstructorDeclaration)
  /ModifierList/Annotation[contains(@SimpleName, 'Generated')]
message: Remove the annotation from hand-written code: JaCoCo skips code carrying an annotation whose name contains Generated, and PIT skips @Generated, so this is not measured. Put the JPA @GeneratedValue on the field.

name: InconsistentFieldLocking
message: This write of a field holds no lock, while another write of the same field in the class holds one: a thread that writes here races with the locked writer, so an update is lost or another thread sees a stale value. Hold the lock the locked write holds for every write of the field (synchronized on the same monitor, or lock() and unlock() of the same Lock), or make the field an atomic or concurrent type (AtomicLong, LongAdder, ConcurrentHashMap). Constructors, initializers, a single write of a volatile field, a write in a lambda and a method the class calls while it holds a lock are not reported.

name: LockOrderInversion
message: This nesting takes two locks of the class in the opposite order to another nesting of the class: two threads that run both can each hold one lock and wait forever for the other, a deadlock that no test reliably shows. Take nested locks in one order everywhere in the class (if any path takes a and then b, no path takes b and then a), or guard the state with one lock. Only locks held in fields of the class, this, Type.class and Type.FIELD are compared; a lock passed in, held in a local or taken in a called method is not followed.

name: LogExceptionFirst
message: Pass the exception first (log.errorf(e, "Cannot read %s", path)), or e.getMessage() when only the text is wanted. After the format, JBoss Logging never logs its stack trace.

name: LogFormatArguments
message: Pass one argument per placeholder, in the method''s own syntax: %s for printf methods (JBoss Logging infof, Log4j 2 printf and formatter loggers), '{'0} for MessageFormat methods (JBoss Logging infov, java.util.logging log), with '''' for an apostrophe there. Keep the format a constant. Otherwise values are dropped or the call throws.

name: LogStringConcatenation
xpath:
//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'config', 'warning', 'severe')]
  [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder')
    or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger')
    or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log')]]
  /ArgumentList/(*[1] | *[1][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String'))]/following-sibling::*[1])

message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.info("user '{'}", user); '{'0} in System.Logger and java.util.logging), not a message built with + or String.format.

name: MutableStaticCollection
xpath:
//FieldDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final']
  [VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]]
  [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private' and VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListSet') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingDeque')])]
  [let $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return
    pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public'
    or ancestor::ClassBody[1]//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('add', 'addAll', 'put', 'putAll', 'putIfAbsent', 'remove', 'clear', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'offer', 'push', 'poll', 'pop', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'removeIf', 'replaceAll', 'sort')]

name: MutationIgnoreMarker
xpath: //Annotation[@SimpleName = ('DoNotMutate', 'CoverageIgnore')]
message: Remove the annotation and kill the mutants with a test: PIT does not mutate code annotated @DoNotMutate or @CoverageIgnore.

name: NegatedOperands
xpath:
//InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')]
  [let $op := @Operator,
       $top := .,
       $chain := ($top, $top//InfixExpression[@Operator = $op]
         [every $between in (ancestor::* intersect $top/descendant::*)
          satisfies $between[self::InfixExpression][@Operator = $op]]),
       $operands := $chain/*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])]
   return not(parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])
     and (every $operand in $operands satisfies $operand[self::UnaryExpression][@Operator = '!'])]
message: Negate once: !a && !b is !(a || b), and !a || !b is !(a && b).

name: SwallowedInterrupt
message: This catch of InterruptedException can complete without rethrowing it or restoring the interrupt, so the interrupt status of the thread is lost and work that was asked to stop keeps running.

name: TaskOutlivesTryResource
xpath:
//MethodCall
  [@MethodName = ('submit', 'execute', 'schedule', 'scheduleAtFixedRate', 'scheduleWithFixedDelay')
      and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Executor')
        or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Timer')]
    or @MethodName = ('supplyAsync', 'runAsync')
      and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture')]
    or @MethodName = ('thenApplyAsync', 'thenAcceptAsync', 'thenRunAsync', 'thenComposeAsync',
                      'whenCompleteAsync', 'handleAsync')
      and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage')]
    or @MethodName = 'startVirtualThread' and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')]
    or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::ConstructorCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')]
    or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::MethodCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread.Builder')]]
  [let $s := .
   return some $block in ancestor::Block[parent::TryStatement[ResourceList]]
   satisfies
     (let $receiver := *[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name,
          $arguments := (ArgumentList/*, *[1][self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/*),
          $resources := $block/parent::TryStatement/ResourceList/Resource,
          $captured := $resources[
            let $name := (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name)
            return exists($arguments[self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodReference
                                     or self::ConstructorCall[AnonymousClassDeclaration]]
                            //VariableAccess[@Name = $name])
              or exists($arguments[self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $name])],
          $chain := $s/ancestor-or-self::MethodCall[
            every $step in ($s/ancestor::* intersect ./descendant::*) satisfies $step/self::MethodCall],
          $top := $chain[1],
          $holder := ($top/parent::VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name,
                      $top/parent::AssignmentExpression[*[2] is $top]/*[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name),
          $uses := $block//VariableAccess[@Name = $holder][. >> $s][not(parent::AssignmentExpression and . is ../*[1])],
          $waits := $block//MethodCall[. >> $s]
            [@MethodName = ('awaitTermination', 'close') and *[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver]
             or @MethodName = 'take' and *[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver]
                [pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService')]
             or @MethodName = 'poll' and ArgumentList[@Size = 2] and *[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver]
                [pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService')]
             or @MethodName = ('await', 'awaitAdvance', 'awaitAdvanceInterruptibly', 'arriveAndAwaitAdvance',
                               'acquire', 'acquireUninterruptibly')
                and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch')
                  or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier')
                  or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Phaser')
                  or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore')]]
            [every $region in ancestor::*[. >> $block]
                [self::CatchClause or self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration
                 or (parent::IfStatement or parent::ConditionalExpression or parent::SwitchStatement
                     or parent::SwitchExpression) and not(. is ../*[1])
                 or (parent::ForeachStatement or parent::ForStatement or parent::WhileStatement)
                    and . is ../*[last()]
                 or parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')] and . is ../*[2]]
             satisfies exists($region intersect $s/ancestor-or-self::*)]
      return exists($captured)
        and not(ancestor::*[self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration][. >> $block])
        and not($chain[@MethodName = ('get', 'join', 'getNow', 'resultNow', 'awaitTermination')])
        and ($top/parent::ExpressionStatement or $top/parent::ReturnStatement
             or (exists($holder) and (every $use in $uses satisfies $use/parent::ReturnStatement)))
        and (some $resource in $captured satisfies empty($resource/following-sibling::Resource[
               (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name) = $receiver]))
        and empty($waits))]
message: The task started by {0}() reads a resource of its try-with-resources, but nothing waits for it after it starts, unconditionally, before the block ends, so the resource is closed while the task can still run. Wait inside the block: get() or join() on the future, awaitTermination or close on the executor, take() or a timed poll() on its CompletionService, await() on a latch or barrier, or declare the executor as a later resource of the same try so it closes first and waits. Or open the resource inside the task.

name: AffixLengthMismatch
message: This substring cuts a different number of characters than the prefix or suffix the code has just tested, so the result keeps a piece of the affix or loses a character of the value (path.startsWith("file://") then path.substring(6) keeps a slash; a quoted string cut with substring(1, s.length() - 2) loses its last character). The code runs and returns a value that is off by one. Cut exactly what was tested: path.substring("file://".length()), s.substring(1, s.length() - 1), or keep the affix in a constant that both the test and the cut use. Right code is not reported: an offset taken from the literal ("file://".length()), an offset equal to the tested length, and a prefix followed by another test of the same value, such as a separator check.

name: AnnotationAttributeNotResolved
xpath:
let $resolving := '^(resolve|evaluate)',
    $guards := ('equals', 'equalsIgnoreCase', 'hasText', 'hasLength', 'isEmpty', 'isBlank', 'isNotEmpty',
                'isNotBlank', 'notNull', 'notEmpty', 'requireNonNull', 'contains', 'startsWith', 'endsWith',
                'debug', 'trace', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'format', 'valueOf'),
    $member := function($c) {
      exists($c[self::MethodCall][ArgumentList/@Size = 0]
        [*[1][self::VariableAccess]]
        [let $n := string(*[1]/@Name)
         return exists(ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1]
                       //(FormalParameter | LocalVariableDeclaration)[.//VariableId/@Name = $n]/ClassType
                       [pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.annotation.Annotation')])]
        [pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String[]')])
    }
return
//MethodCall[$member(.)]
  [parent::ArgumentList[not(parent::*[self::MethodCall][@MethodName = $guards])]]
  [not(ancestor::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $resolving)])]
  [let $var := *[1]/@Name,
       $name := @MethodName,
       $siblings := distinct-values(
         ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1]
           //MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $resolving)]/ArgumentList//MethodCall
           [$member(.)][*[1]/@Name = $var]/@MethodName)
   return count($siblings) >= 2 and not($name = $siblings)]
message: This annotation attribute is used as it is, while other attributes of the same annotation instance in this method go through resolve(...), resolveEmbeddedValue, resolveStringValue, resolvePlaceholders or evaluate(...). A property placeholder or SpEL expression in its value is then taken literally. Resolve it like its siblings: endpoint.setConsumes(resolve(listener.consumes())). An attribute that is meant to be literal (a class name, an id) can stay raw; then read it before the resolved ones or pass it to a method that documents it as literal.

name: AssertNotNullWrongCheck
xpath:
//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.springframework.util.Assert#notNull(_*)')
             or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.springframework.util.Assert#isNull(_*)')]
  [ArgumentList/*[1][
      pmd-java:typeIs('boolean') or pmd-java:typeIs('int') or pmd-java:typeIs('long')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('double') or pmd-java:typeIs('float') or pmd-java:typeIs('short')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('byte') or pmd-java:typeIs('char')
      or self::UnaryExpression[@Operator = '!']
      or self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('==', '!=', '<', '>', '<=', '>=', '&&', '||')]
      or self::InstanceOfExpression]
   or @MethodName = 'notNull' and ArgumentList/@Size = 2
      and ArgumentList/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::MethodCall]
        [pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.CharSequence') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection')
         or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]
      and ArgumentList/*[2][self::StringLiteral][matches(@Image, '(not|n.t|never|or|nor|be|is|are) +(be +)?([Ee]mpty|[Bb]lank)([^a-z]|$)')]]
message: The Spring methods Assert.notNull and Assert.isNull test for null, but this call checks something else: a boolean or number is boxed and never null, and a String, Collection or Map whose message says empty or blank passes when it is empty. The assertion always holds and the invalid value goes through. Test the condition with Assert.isTrue(count >= 0, "count must not be negative"), and use Assert.hasText(name, "name must not be empty"), Assert.hasLength or Assert.notEmpty for text and collections. Assert.notNull(name, "name must not be null") on its own is fine.

name: BlockingInCompletionStage
xpath:
//MethodCall
  [(@MethodName = 'join' and ArgumentList[@Size = 0]
      and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinTask')])
    or (@MethodName = 'get' and ArgumentList[@Size = 0] and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Future')])
    or (@MethodName = 'get' and ArgumentList[@Size = 2][not(*[1][self::NumericLiteral][@ValueAsInt = 0])]
        and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Future')])
    or (@MethodName = 'await' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch')])
    or (@MethodName = 'take' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue')])
    or (@MethodName = 'put' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue')])
    or (@MethodName = ('acquire', 'acquireUninterruptibly') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore')])
    or (pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Thread#sleep(_*)') and not(ArgumentList/*[1][self::NumericLiteral][@ValueAsInt = 0]))]
  [not(@MethodName = 'put')
   or (let $queue := string(*[1]/@Name)
       return empty(ancestor::CompilationUnit//VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $queue]/ConstructorCall
         [ClassType[@SimpleName = 'LinkedTransferQueue'] or (ClassType[@SimpleName = ('LinkedBlockingQueue', 'LinkedBlockingDeque')]
                                                              and ArgumentList[@Size = 0])]))]
  [let $lambda := ancestor::*[self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration][1][self::LambdaExpression],
       $stage := $lambda/parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall
         [@MethodName = ('thenAccept', 'thenApply', 'thenCompose', 'thenRun', 'thenCombine', 'thenAcceptBoth',
                         'whenComplete', 'handle', 'exceptionally', 'applyToEither', 'acceptEither')]
         [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage')]],
       $root := (*[1]/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess])[1],
       $receiver := string($root/@Name),
       $method := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1]
   return exists($stage)
     and not($receiver = $lambda/LambdaParameterList//VariableId/@Name)
     and empty(ancestor::CompilationUnit//VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $receiver]/*[2]
                 /descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('completedFuture', 'failedFuture', 'completedStage')])
     and not($receiver = $stage/*[1]/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name)
     and not($receiver = $method//ForeachStatement/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name)
     and empty($lambda//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('isDone', 'isCompletedExceptionally', 'isCancelled')]
                 [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][@Name = $receiver]])
     and empty($method//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('allOf', 'anyOf', 'waitForAll')])]
message: Hand the wait to an executor or compose instead of blocking: use the Async variant with an executor (source.thenAcceptAsync(value -> save(value), executor)), return the next stage from thenCompose instead of calling join() on it, or read an already completed future with getNow(null). A stage without the Async suffix runs on the thread that completes its source future, often a Netty I/O thread or a client callback thread, so a get(), join(), await(), take() or sleep() here stalls every other task queued on that thread and can deadlock when the awaited work needs the same thread. An exception fits when the source always completes on a pool made for blocking work.

name: BufferNeverReleased
xpath:
let $allocators := ('buffer', 'directBuffer', 'heapBuffer', 'ioBuffer', 'compositeBuffer', 'compositeDirectBuffer'),
    $reads := '^(get|set|read|write|is|has|can|skip|index|bytes|ensure|capacity|readable|writable|equals|hashCode|toString|refCnt|clear|mark|reset|order|max|forEach|compareTo)',
    $fluent := '^(write|set|clear|mark|reset|skip|ensure|discard)',
    $shares := 'Slice|Retained|Duplicate|Sink|Readonly',
    $allocates := function($init) {
      exists($init[self::MethodCall]
        [(@MethodName = $allocators
          and (*[1][self::MethodCall][@MethodName = 'alloc']
               or *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBufAllocator')]
               or *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('io.netty.buffer.Unpooled')][../@MethodName = 'directBuffer']))
         or (@MethodName = ('retain', 'readRetainedSlice', 'retainedSlice', 'retainedDuplicate') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf')])
         or (matches(@MethodName, '^encode') and pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf'))])
    },
    $onlyRead := function($u) {
      ($u/parent::MethodCall[*[1] is $u][matches(@MethodName, $reads)][not(matches(@MethodName, $shares))]
         [parent::ExpressionStatement or not(matches(@MethodName, $fluent))])
      or ($u/parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('equals', 'compareTo', 'writeBytes', 'setBytes')])
    }
return
  //LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator
    [VariableId[pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf')]]

Release each element in its own try/catch, collect the failures, and rethrow the first one with the others added as suppressed (try (...) around each element, or a helper that does this). An exception fits only when a failed release should abort the remaining ones.

message: Forward the failure to the result: return the composed stage (return source.thenCompose(value -> next(value))), or chain .exceptionally(error -> fail(result, error)) with a method that calls result.completeExceptionally(error), or read the throwable in whenComplete (value, error) and call completeExceptionally(error) when it is not null. name: ConcatenationComparedWithNull
message: A string concatenation is compared with null. A concatenation is never null, so == null is always false and != null is always true, and the value that was meant to be tested is never checked. + binds tighter than == and !=, so "id=" + name != null ? name.trim() : "none" reads ("id=" + name) != null ? ...; when a conditional follows, put the parentheses around it: "id=" + (name != null ? name.trim() : "none"). Otherwise compare the value itself with null, or drop the comparison.

name: ConcurrentMapCheckThenAct
message: This concurrent map is checked and then used again for the same key (containsKey or get(key) == null, then put, get or remove), but another thread can change the entry between the two calls: two threads both see it absent and both create the value, or the get returns null after containsKey said true. A ConcurrentMap makes each call atomic, not the pair. Use one atomic call: map.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> create(k)), map.putIfAbsent(key, value), map.getOrDefault(key, fallback), map.computeIfPresent or merge, or read once into a local (Value v = map.get(key); if (v == null) ...). An exception fits a map that only one thread changes, or a pair that is already locked.

name: ConstantIndexBeyondGuard
message: This literal index is larger than the length the guard around it has proved. The guard lets through exactly the length at which the access throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException or IndexOutOfBoundsException (params.length > 1 ? params[2] : null, if (parts.length < 1) return; then parts[1]). Raise the guard to the index used (params.length > 2, parts.length < 2) or lower the index. Right code is not reported: a guard that admits the index (params.length > 2 ? params[2] : null), a receiver that is reassigned in the method, a variable index, and a receiver whose length is read in any other way before the access.

name: DatePatternLetterSlip
message: This date-time pattern mixes up its letters, and none of these throws: MM after an hour is the month (HH:MM), mm next to dd or yy is the minute (dd.mm.yyyy), HH:ss leaves the minutes out, yyy and yyyyy give odd years, kk and KK are the hours 1-24 and 0-11, and hh without a is a 12-hour clock with no marker (also with HH in the same pattern). The wrong values reach logs, file names and screens. Write the minutes as mm and the month as MM ("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm"), the year as yyyy or yy, the 24-hour clock as HH, and add a for hh. An exception fits a display that wants kk or KK on purpose.

name: DelimitedLookupKey
message: This map or set key joins two runtime strings with a delimiter, so the pairs "a-b" and "c", and "a" and "b-c", produce the same key: one entry overwrites or answers for another. Key it with a record, List.of(a, b) or a nested map, or encode the parts so the delimiter cannot appear in them. A number, an enum, an id that cannot hold the delimiter and a literal are fine.

name: EpochNarrowedToInt
message: An epoch time is cut to a 32-bit int here: epoch milliseconds overflow at once, and epoch seconds overflow in 2038 and turn a long lifetime into a date in the past. Keep epoch times in a long or an Instant (long expiresAt = Instant.now().getEpochSecond() + lifetimeSeconds), and compare them as long values.

name: UnboundedThreadPool

name: SecretDigestEquals
message: A password hash or secret digest is compared with equals. PasswordEncoder.encode of a salted encoder (bcrypt, PBKDF2, Argon2) picks a new salt on every call, so its result never equals the stored value: use passwordEncoder.matches(raw, stored). message: Do not assert exact equality with a fractional floating-point literal: a computed 0.1 + 0.2 differs from 0.3 in the last bits, so the test fails on rounding noise or passes by luck. Give the comparison a tolerance: assertEquals(expected, actual, delta) in JUnit and TestNG, assertThat(actual).isCloseTo(expected, within(1e-9)) in AssertJ, or assertThat(actual, closeTo(expected, 1e-9)) in Hamcrest. The same goes for assertTrue(x == 0.1), assertThat(x == 0.1).isTrue() and Double.compare(x, 0.1) == 0. An integral literal such as 1.0 is exact and allowed.

           pmd-java:typeIs('org.junit.Before')
        or pmd-java:typeIs('org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach')
        or pmd-java:typeIs('org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll')
        or pmd-java:typeIs('org.testng.annotations.BeforeMethod')
        or pmd-java:typeIs('org.testng.annotations.BeforeClass')
    ])]
    (: Make sure this is a JUnit 4/5 or TestNG class :)
    [../MethodDeclaration[
               pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.Test')
            or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.junit.jupiter.api.Test')
            or pmd-java:hasAnnotation('org.testng.annotations.Test')
    ]]
message: Apply the correct annotation if this method is used to set up the tests

name: UnitTestShouldUseTestAnnotation
message: Unit tests should use the @Test annotation or won't be run. In case of JUnit 5, test methods might use @RepeatedTest, @TestFactory, @TestTemplate or @ParameterizedTest annotations instead.

name: UseStandardCharsets
message: Please use StandardCharsets constants

name: UseVarargs
xpath:
//FormalParameters[not(parent::MethodDeclaration[@Overridden=true() or @MainMethod=true()])]
  /FormalParameter[position()=last()]
   [@Varargs=false()]
   [ArrayType[not(PrimitiveType[@Kind = "byte"] or ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Byte')])]
    or VariableId[ArrayDimensions] and (PrimitiveType[not(@Kind="byte")] or ClassType[not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Byte'))])]
message: Consider using varargs for methods or constructors which take an array the last parameter.

name: WhileLoopWithLiteralBoolean
xpath:
(: while loops with single boolean literal 'false', maybe parenthesized :)
//WhileStatement/BooleanLiteral[@True = false()]
|
(: do-while loops with single boolean literal ('false' or 'true'), maybe parenthesized :)
//DoStatement/BooleanLiteral
|
(: while loops with conditional or'ed boolean literals, maybe parenthesized :)
//WhileStatement[(InfixExpression[@Operator = ('|', '||')])
    (: no var access :)
    [count(VariableAccess) = 0]
    (: at least one false literal :)
    [count(BooleanLiteral[@True = false()]) >= 1]]
|
(: while loops with conditional and'ed boolean literals, maybe parenthesized :)
//WhileStatement[(InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&', '&&')])
    (: at least one false literal :)
    [count(BooleanLiteral[@True = false()]) >= 1]]
|
(: do-while loops with conditional or'ed boolean literals, maybe parenthesized :)
//DoStatement[(InfixExpression[@Operator = ('|', '||')])
    (: at least one true literal :)
    [count(BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]) >= 1
      (: or only boolean literal and no no var access :)
      or count(BooleanLiteral) >= 1
      and count(VariableAccess) = 0
    ]]
|
(: do-while loops with conditional and'ed boolean literals, maybe parenthesized :)
//DoStatement[(InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&', '&&')])
    (: at least one false literal :)
    [count(BooleanLiteral[@True = false()]) >= 1
      (: or only boolean literal and no no var access :)
      or count(BooleanLiteral) >= 1
      and count(VariableAccess) = 0
    ]]
message: The loop can be simplified.

name: AvoidCalendarDateCreation
xpath:
//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Calendar#getTime()") or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Calendar#getTimeInMillis()")]
  [*[1][local-name() = ('MethodCall', 'ConstructorCall')]
                               [pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Calendar#getInstance()")
                             or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.GregorianCalendar#getInstance()")
                             or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.GregorianCalendar#new()")]
  ]
|
//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Calendar#getTime()") or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Calendar#getTimeInMillis()")]
   [*[1][local-name() = 'VariableAccess']]
  (: ignore if .set* or .add or .clear or .roll is called on the variable :)
  [not(VariableAccess/@Name = ancestor::Block//MethodCall[starts-with(@MethodName, "set") or @MethodName = ("add", "clear", "roll")]/VariableAccess/@Name)]
  (: variable must be initialized with getInstance :)
  [VariableAccess/@Name = ancestor::Block//LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator[
     (MethodCall | ConstructorCall)
      [pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Calendar#getInstance()")
       or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.GregorianCalendar#getInstance()")
       or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.GregorianCalendar#new()")]
  ]/VariableId/@Name]
|
//ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs("org.joda.time.DateTime") or pmd-java:typeIs("org.joda.time.LocalDateTime")]
  [ArgumentList[(MethodCall | ConstructorCall)
       [pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Calendar#getInstance()")
     or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.GregorianCalendar#getInstance()")
     or pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.GregorianCalendar#new()")]]
  ]
message: A Calendar is used to get the current time, this is expensive.

name: OptimizableToArrayCall
xpath:
//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig("java.util.Collection#toArray(_)")]
    [ArgumentList/ArrayAllocation/ArrayType/ArrayDimensions/ArrayDimExpr[not(NumericLiteral[@Image="0"])]]
message: This call to Collection.toArray() may be optimizable

name: StringToString
xpath: //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig("java.lang.String#toString()")]
message: Avoid calling toString() on String objects; this is unnecessary.

name: UseArrayListInsteadOfVector

name: UseIOStreamsWithApacheCommonsFileItem
message: Avoid memory intensive FileItem.get() or FileItem.getString()

name: UseStringBufferLength
xpath:
//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('_#length()')
    and MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.CharSequence#toString()')]]
|
(: finds sb.toString().equals(someVar) where var is a final variable initialized with literal "" :)
//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('_#equals(_)')
  and MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.AbstractStringBuilder#toString()')]
  and ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = //VariableDeclarator[StringLiteral[@Image='""']]
                                            /VariableId[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final']/@Name]]
|
(: finds sb.toString().equals("") :)
//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('_#equals(_)')
  and MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.AbstractStringBuilder#toString()')]
  and ArgumentList/StringLiteral[@Image='""']]
message: This is an inefficient use of CharSequence.toString; call CharSequence.length instead.

name: AvoidSynchronizedAtMethodLevel
xpath: //MethodDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = "synchronized"]
message: Use block level locking rather than method level synchronization

name: AvoidSynchronizedStatement
xpath: //SynchronizedStatement
message: Use ReentrantLock rather than synchronization

name: AvoidThreadGroup
xpath:
//ConstructorCall/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.ThreadGroup')]
| //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'getThreadGroup']
message: Avoid using java.lang.ThreadGroup; it is not thread safe

name: UseNotifyAllInsteadOfNotify
xpath: //MethodCall[@MethodName="notify" and ArgumentList[count(*) = 0]]
message: Call Thread.notifyAll() rather than Thread.notify()

name: AvoidArrayLoops
xpath:
//(ForStatement[ForUpdate//(UnaryExpression[@Operator=('++','--')] | AssignmentExpression[@Operator = ('+=', '-=')][NumericLiteral[@Image = '1']])]
 | WhileStatement | DoStatement)
    [not(.//ContinueStatement)]
    [not(.//BreakStatement)]
    [not(.//ThrowStatement)]
    [not(.//ReturnStatement)]
    [count(Block//AssignmentExpression[@Operator='=']
                                      (: no nested arrays or method calls as array index :)
                                      [count(ArrayAccess[not(.//ArrayAccess)]
                                                        [not(.//MethodCall)])=2]
                                      (: array access indexes must be same (excluding constants) :)
                                      [deep-equal(
                                        sort(distinct-values(ArrayAccess[1]/(VariableAccess[2]|InfixExpression//VariableAccess)
                                            (: don't consider array length accesses :)
                                            [not(parent::FieldAccess[@Name='length'])]
                                            [
                                               (: exclude referenced constants :)
                                               not(@Name = (ancestor::MethodDeclaration|//FieldDeclaration)//VariableDeclarator[NumericLiteral][not(../../../parent::ForInit)]/VariableId/@Name)
                                               or
                                               (: include loop variable :)
                                               @Name = ancestor::ForStatement/ForInit/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name
                                            ]
                                            /@Name)),
                                        sort(distinct-values(ArrayAccess[2]/(VariableAccess[2]|InfixExpression//VariableAccess)
                                            (: don't consider array length accesses :)
                                            [not(parent::FieldAccess[@Name='length'])]
                                            [
                                               (: exclude referenced constants :)
                                               not(@Name = (ancestor::MethodDeclaration|//FieldDeclaration)//VariableDeclarator[NumericLiteral][not(../../../parent::ForInit)]/VariableId/@Name)
                                               or
                                               (: include loop variable :)
                                               @Name = ancestor::ForStatement/ForInit/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name
                                            ]
                                            /@Name))
                                      )]
     )=1]
message: Arrays.copyOf or System.arraycopy are more efficient

name: AvoidFileStream
message: Avoid instantiating FileInputStream, FileOutputStream, FileReader, or FileWriter

name: UseArraysAsList
message: Use asList instead of tight loops

name: DontCallThreadRun
xpath: //MethodCall[ pmd-java:matchesSig("java.lang.Thread#run()") ]
message: Don't call Thread.run() explicitly, use Thread.start()

name: AvoidCatchingGenericException
xpath:
//CatchParameter//ClassType[
        pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.NullPointerException') or
        pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Exception') or
        pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.RuntimeException')]
message: Avoid catching generic exceptions such as NullPointerException, RuntimeException, Exception in try-catch block

name: SimplifyBooleanExpressions
xpath: //InfixExpression[@Operator = ("==", "!=")]/BooleanLiteral
message: Drop the comparison with a boolean literal: x == true and x != false are x, x == false and x != true are !x.

name: SimplifiedTernary
xpath: //ConditionalExpression[BooleanLiteral and not(NullLiteral)]
message: Write the boolean ternary with a logical operator: c ? true : x is c || x, c ? false : x is !c && x, c ? x : true is !c || x, c ? x : false is c && x.

name: CollapsibleIfStatements
message: Merge the nested if into its parent with &&: if (a) '{' if (b) '{' ... } } is if (a && b) '{' ... }.

name: LogicInversion
xpath: //UnaryExpression[@Operator='!']/InfixExpression[@Operator = ('==', '!=', '<', '>', '<=', '>=')]
message: Use the opposite operator instead of negating the comparison: !(a == b) is a != b, !(a < b) is a >= b.
suppress:
.[@Operator = ('<', '>', '<=', '>=')]
  [*[pmd-java:typeIs('double') or pmd-java:typeIs('float')
     or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Double') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Float')]]

name: AvoidThrowingRawExceptionTypes
xpath:
//ThrowStatement//ConstructorCall
 /ClassType[
 pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Throwable')
or
 pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Exception')
or
 pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Error')

message: Throw a specific exception (IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException or a project exception), not RuntimeException, Exception, Throwable or Error.
